title: The BEST Gear Before Scorned Wilderness! | Dragonwilds Best-in-Slot Progression Guide
author: Thurnax
description:
The Umbral Sands is the final progression region currently available in Dragonwilds—and the last stop before the Fight Caves.

In this Best-in-Slot progression guide, I'll cover the best armor, weapons, shields, trinkets, food, consumables, and gathering tools for melee, ranged, and magic before taking on Fuzan.

We'll also go over which upgrades are worth chasing, what you should prioritize while exploring the desert, and how to prepare for one of the toughest encounters currently in the game.

📌 In this guide:
Best melee gear in Umbral Sands
Best ranged progression
Best magic progression
Adamant vs Obsidian Armor
Dorgeshuun Crossbow & Bow of Elidinis
Necromancy Staff progression
Amulet of Glory farming
Obsidian Cape
Fight Caves preparation
Fuzan preparation
Best food, infusions & consumables

This is the final region in my Best-in-Slot Progression Series based on the current version of Dragonwilds. As future content releases—including the Scorned Wilderness update—I’ll continue updating these guides so they stay current.

Dedicated Fight Caves, Fuzan, and additional boss guides for melee, ranged, and magic are coming soon.

Looking for other Dragonwilds players? Join the Thurnax Enclave Discord community to share builds, ask questions, and stay up to date with future guides.

If this guide helped you, consider liking the video and subscribing for more Dragonwilds content.

— Thurnax
